content.title:
UIA Talent Agency on Instagram: "It is with profound sadness that we share the passing of our UIA family and opera community member, Rainelle Krause. 

Rainelle was a radiant artist whose extraordinary promise was only just beginning to unfold. Having recently made her debut at the Metropolitan Opera as the Queen of the Night, she stood at the threshold of what we all knew would be a remarkable career. It was a privilege to represent and work with Rainelle. Yet what we will remember most is not only her exceptional voice, but that she was a shining light in our artistic family, whose warmth, sincerity, and generosity of spirit touched all who knew her.

Taken from us far too soon, she will be deeply missed and always remembered with great affection. Our hearts are with her family, friends, and all who knew and loved her during this incredibly difficult time.

Rest in power, beautiful Queen."
